item.title: First post in my new blog
item.description: I used to manage my blog since last July using hugo static site generator. But after recovering my Macbook Air through DFU mode, I had to lost all of my data include my projects, some system tweaks and even original hugo blog data. My original hugo theme was “LoveIt” and it has a lot of features for developer such as line number in code block, content shortcut buttons, and perfect shortcodes.
